title: ICT 2024 Mentorship - Complete Lecture Knowledge Catalog (Lectures 1–52)

lectures.topic: The 2024 Model Introduction & Economic Calendar Gating
lectures.key_takeaways: NFP (Non-Farm Payrolls) week trading boundaries. Standing down on Thursdays and Fridays of NFP week due to institutional Seek & Destroy volatility profiles.

lectures.topic: Interbank Order Flow & Session Reference Ranges
lectures.key_takeaways: Mapping the 20:00 to 02:00 EST Asian range. Why high and low boundaries act as institutional magnet pools for the London open.
Detailed dissection of the 02:00-03:00 EST false breakout. How to differentiate between a runaway expansion and a liquidity raid.

lectures.topic: Market Structure Shifts on the 5-Minute Timeframe
lectures.key_takeaways: Displacement criteria: energetic expansion candle with dominant body and small wicks leaving an imbalance (FVG).

lectures.topic: Fair Value Gap Classification (BISI vs SIBI)
lectures.key_takeaways: 3-bar gap geometry. Why the second bar must be completely free of overlapping wicks from bar 1 and bar 3.
The 50% midpoint of an FVG is the institutional line in the sand. Price can wick to C.E., but bodies closing beyond C.E. signals structural failure.
Using Fib 0.50 level on the reference range. Disqualifying any short signal that triggers below Equilibrium.
Hidden liquidity pockets inside consolidating ranges. When to target internal liquidity vs external liquidity.

lectures.topic: Advanced Consequent Encroachment Rules & Rejection Blocks
lectures.key_takeaways: Body closes are the sole arbiter of institutional intent. Rejection blocks formed at swing extremes.
Correlation between EUR/USD, GBP/USD, and Dollar Index (DXY). SMT Divergences at the London open.

lectures.topic: New York AM Killzone Order Flow
lectures.key_takeaways: 08:00 AM EST pre-market injection. The 08:30 AM macro and red folder news releases.
Equities open volatility. Why waiting for the initial 15-minute price discovery provides superior risk-to-reward.
18:50 to 20:15 EST CME re-open. Why Asian macro setups must be target-based with early partials at 1.5R.
Rules for invalidating an entry if the 5m candle immediately violates the FVG midpoint.
Micro Gold (MGC), Micro Silver (SIL), Micro Nasdaq (MNQ). Contract sizing and tick value risk management.
Comparing correlated assets (e.g. NQ making a higher high while ES makes a lower high) to spot accumulation.
Never widening a stop loss. Protecting capital at all costs. The psychology of systematic execution.

lectures.topic: Candle Body MSS vs Wick Fakeouts Final Rule
lectures.key_takeaways: Codifying the absolute requirement for 5m candle body closure across swing points.
Quarantining trades when the 09:30 AM open is trapped inside the 09:00-09:30 AM range. The definitive filter against opening chop.

lectures.topic: The Double Tap Framework & Defensive Shields
lectures.key_takeaways: Center Mass 1.5R partials + Head Shot 3.0R runners + Breakeven + 2 ticks buffer. The complete synthesis of the 2024 model.
